entries.description: Worked on Quickbooks Online Payroll Team
highlights: AI Agent Architecture: Led the technical design and implementation of an autonomous AI agent to troubleshoot complex customer issues and resolve help inquiries. Drove the project from proof of concept to production, reducing human agent support cases by 4% within the first quarter of launch

Legacy System Modernization: Drove the technical strategy for a mission critical desktop to online customer migration pipeline. Architected a resilient migration engine that achieved over 90% data accuracy, a significant improvement over the legacy system's 60% capability.

Automated Resolution Pipeline: Architected an event driven remediation system for tax notice resolutions. Engineered a downstream service to process extracted JSON payloads and automatically execute the required customer configuration state changes, driving an 80% zero touch resolution rate.

entries.description: Worked on the Orders and Return Management System
highlights: Return Rate Reduction: Architected core modifications to the return and refund calculation pipelines to support dynamic fee application. Engineered the refund processing workflows to automatically claw back shipping fees and attach return penalties for flagged abusive accounts, driving down the abusive user return rate from over 60% to under 20% and preserving significant gross margin.

Fulfillment & Return Architecture: Engineered the core backend workflows for the "Open Box Delivery" fraud prevention initiative. Redesigned packing and warehouse assignment algorithms, and overhauled the downstream return processing pipeline to support the new logistics protocol, yielding yearly business savings of over ₹35 Crores.

Differential Refund Workflows: Redesigned refund calculation pipelines and processing workflows to support a real time price protection feature. Engineered the backend systems to accurately process differential refunds and seamlessly incentivize payouts via the Myntra Wallet, reducing total return/RTO volume from 41% to 36% and driving a 220 basis point increase in wallet adoption.

entries.description: Worked on an industry leading Transportation  Management solution. The product helps clients manage transport throughout a global supply chain. Clients can optimize on costs, delivery time etc.
highlights: Enterprise Billing Architecture: Designed and implemented core architectural components for multiparty billing, enabling seamless invoice/bill consolidation and post approval adjustments for industry leading transportation workflows.

Database Migration Tooling: Implemented a custom database migration framework, providing Liquibase style functionality for the engineering organization. Developed the core execution engine to ensure reliable, ordered, and reproducible database schema evolutions.
